objective: Determine the minimum honest conversion of the M216/M218/M219/M220 K8 FC2 frontend/service into an executable destination-major G4 adapter shared by binary FC1 and 3x3 Conv, while preserving an exact beta=0 path and fencing beta=48 as an accuracy-gated candidate.

frozen_opportunity.scope_warning: All task and cycle values in this section are checkpoint/trace analytical opportunity. They exclude mask fetch, bitmap scan, bank conflict, line-buffer, response, accumulator, scale/bias and commit overhead.

reuse_directly: ready/valid header, payload, done and token ownership shell
eight fixed source banks and bank/source invariant source_id[2:0] == bank_id
one oldest source priority selector per bank
up to eight selected sources per accepted group
authoritative done fence and fail-closed malformed tag/count behavior
must_replace_or_reinterpret: Replace FC2 consecutive-window pair merge with one destination-group scratch bitmap per buffer.
Replace output-block replay with dest_group_id and context identity.
Extend dense Conv storage from 8x96-bit descriptors / 96 sources per bank to at least 9x96-bit descriptors / 108 sources per bank.
Do not reuse the M214 raw4 compactor as the FC1/Conv semantic frontend; only its fail-closed packet discipline is portable.

reuse_directly: soft-flush request/ack, stale-response quarantine and timeout
active-bank request accounting and protocol/overflow counters
must_replace_or_reshape: Replace fixed 8 output blocks x 6 slices x 16 lanes Acc24 context with addressable context_slot x dest_group x 4 lanes storage.
Replace six fixed 16-lane requests per group with one G4 request, or four independently addressed G4 requests only after the memory-port DSE.
Replace FC2 output_block/slice identity with op_mode/module/context/dest_group identity.
A single G4 response is 8 banks x 4 INT8 = 256 bits; G4x4 remains 1024 bits but requires four addresses per source bank.

reuse_map.source: M219 native cropped K1 service and M220 miter
reuse_directly: M219 as the narrow golden reference/fallback service, not as the performance endpoint
M220 bounded identity matrix, recurrence auditor and always-ready/stall response-order attacks
must_add: FC1 G4 K1-vs-K8 arithmetic miter across beta=0 and beta=48 masks
separate Conv3x3 software reference that preserves padding, stride, tap and context identity

reuse_directly: separate read/write conflict and transition accounting
not_reusable_as_rtl: The modeled 96-byte weight and 144-byte PWP ports have no VCS, macro or timing proof.
The materializer itself changes 352,335,120 cycles by only 2,530 cycles (1.00000718x); it is not a speedup source for this adapter.

minimum_unified_interface.g4x4_response: signed int8 weight[4 group_lanes][8 banks][4 destinations], 1024-bit payload; requires four independent source addresses per bank per cycle

required_new_state.purpose: Latch op_mode, module geometry, beta mode, checkpoint/mask identity and context limits only while idle.
Conv only: maintain a three-row binary line buffer, 3x3 window generator, stride/padding counters and output-pixel context identity.
Build the active source bitmap for one FC1 token or one Conv output pixel; Conv source identity is input_channel*9+tap.
Read the current and next destination-group mask columns into ping-pong scratch storage; beta=0 synthesizes all-ones without reading lossy metadata.
For the current destination group compute remaining = active & keep_column, select at most one source per modulo-8 bank, issue K8, and clear only accepted sources.
Reuse M218 FIFO/O8 scoreboard and hold the exact request identity under memory backpressure.
Reuse M218 response authentication and skid, then reduce 8 signed INT8 weights into four addressable Acc24 lanes.
Advance only after the current scratch bitmap is empty and all causally prior updates to that group are owned.
Apply or export per-row bias/scale/dequant identity; this bridge is required before claiming original-model numerical exactness.
Drain addressable destination groups and retire the token/pixel using an authoritative done fence.
Reuse epoch flush, stale-response quarantine, timeout and fail-closed protocol behavior.

scheduler_direction.algorithm: For each destination group, form remaining_source_bitmap = active_source_bitmap AND keep_mask_column; select one oldest source from each modulo-8 bank, issue the resulting bank_valid/source_id vector, clear accepted bits, then advance to the next destination group.
scheduler_direction.reason: At beta=48 retained source/group probability is 0.6763 for FC1 and 0.6298 for Conv. OR-ing eight sources makes an all-skipped K8 bundle extremely rare, so request cycles remain nearly dense even though active-bank energy falls. Task removal becomes executable cycle removal only with destination-major per-group compaction.

beta0_exact_path.keep_mask: force all ones; do not consult beta48 metadata
beta0_exact_path.coverage: include every active source x destination-group task, including weights whose magnitude is zero, because the frozen beta=0 DSE is keep-all
beta0_exact_path.ordering: preserve source, tap, destination-group, padding, stride, token and pixel-context identity
beta0_exact_path.scheduler: use the same destination-major K8 scheduler and accumulator path as beta48; no hidden K1 fallback
beta0_exact_path.numeric_claim: bit-exact to a dense INT8 reference only after per-row scale, bias and dequant identity are included; not automatically exact to the original floating-point forward
required_checks: no duplicate or dropped source/group task
FC1 and Conv accumulator equality under stalls and out-of-order responses
no use before active bitmap, mask column or line-buffer context is valid

beta48_additional_gate.enable_boundary: accept mode change only while idle and fenced at a token boundary
beta48_additional_gate.identity: whitelist checkpoint SHA, module list SHA, weight/mask SHA, quantization identity, no_running BN contract and exact ordered sample IDs
beta48_additional_gate.accuracy_protocol: same frozen checkpoint and ordered S10 samples; run beta=0 first, then beta=48; maximum absolute AEE increase <= 0.02
beta48_additional_gate.failure_behavior: missing, stale or mismatched mask fails closed; token-boundary fallback to beta=0 is permitted only if explicitly signaled, otherwise hard fault
beta48_additional_gate.conservation: selected_task_count + skipped_task_count must equal beta0 task count per module/context/destination group
promotion_order: only then DC/PT/energy and performance promotion

definitions.m218_k8: 8 sources x 16 destinations = 128 source-destination contributions per ideal request
definitions.m219_k1: 1 source x 16 destinations = 16 contributions per ideal request
definitions.single_g4_k8: 8 sources x 4 destinations = 32 contributions per ideal request
definitions.g4x4_k8: 4 independent destination groups x 8 sources x 4 destinations = 128 contributions per ideal cycle

single_g4_k8_beta48.interpretation: A single-G4 adapter can honestly calibrate an approximately 3x result against cropped K1, but it is 2.52-2.71x slower than the existing 16-lane M218 K8 geometry before overhead. It is not the final performance architecture.

g4x4_k8_beta48_ideal.interpretation: These are upper bounds before mask fetch, bank conflict, line buffer, scoreboard, accumulator and commit costs.

existing_service_context.warning: These are FC2 frontend/service results and cannot be transferred as FC1/Conv measured cycles.

memory_and_physical_blockers.finding: Four independent G4 lanes usually request four different source addresses from each modulo-8 bank in the same cycle. M218 has one read per bank, not four.
memory_and_physical_blockers.impact: A real G4x4 design needs 32 physical banks, four-way replication/multiporting, or serialization. Serialization removes the expected incremental speedup.
memory_and_physical_blockers.exit_criterion: Choose a bank mapping with an executable conflict schedule and macro-feasible ports before G4x4 RTL.

memory_and_physical_blockers.finding: M218 logic-only DC area is 88,851.042296 um2 and contains 21,116 sequential cells; its 18,432-bit Acc24 context is 87.289% of sequential state.
memory_and_physical_blockers.impact: Replicating four service lanes or retaining FC2-shaped contexts can dominate area/clock power. The unified context must be macro-backed and addressable, with valid/epoch ownership rather than bulk reset.

memory_and_physical_blockers.finding: Fixed beta48 source/group masks total 136,368 bytes. The largest Conv column is 864 bits, 108 bits per modulo-8 bank.
memory_and_physical_blockers.impact: Without column-oriented banking and current/next prefetch, mask fetch can cost as much as or more than a short source scan.

memory_and_physical_blockers.finding: Dense beta=0 Conv has 864 source keys, 108 per bank; M216's current 8x96-bit windows and 96-per-bank guard are too small.
memory_and_physical_blockers.impact: A naive reuse fails beta=0 exactness or requires an unmodeled extra tile. Extend to nine descriptor rows/108 sources per bank or make tiling explicit in the cycle model.

memory_and_physical_blockers.finding: No reviewed artifact implements the Conv three-row line buffer, 3x3 window generator, stride/padding fences or per-pixel context lifetime.
memory_and_physical_blockers.impact: Conv task removal is not executable until source bitmap construction and line-buffer stalls are modeled.

memory_and_physical_blockers.finding: M288/M295 task ledgers stop before bias, scale, dequant, BN and destination commit.
memory_and_physical_blockers.impact: Raw Acc24 bounds and task equality are insufficient for model-output exactness, AEE or end-to-end cycle claims.

memory_and_physical_blockers.finding: An approximately 3x single-G4 number exists only against the cropped K1 service. M218 K8 already exposes roughly 4.95x over K1 in its FC2 service premodel.
memory_and_physical_blockers.impact: Using K1 alone as the paper headline would hide regression versus the strongest existing K8 architecture. Report K1, M218-equivalent K8 and M221 envelope baselines together.

recommended_implementation_sequence.deliverable: Single-G4 K8 destination-major frontend + 256-bit service response + addressable G4 accumulator
recommended_implementation_sequence.purpose: Obtain executable beta0 cycles, expose scan/mask/commit overhead and reuse the maximum proven protocol shell.

recommended_implementation_sequence.deliverable: FC1 beta0 arithmetic miter and Conv3x3 padding/stride/tap miter under stalls, OOO responses, flush and malformed identity attacks
Column-oriented mask SRAM adapter with current/next prefetch and beta48 identity gate
recommended_implementation_sequence.purpose: Convert M288/M295 task removal into measured selected/skipped cycles.

recommended_implementation_sequence.deliverable: G4x4 memory-port DSE: 32-bank mapping versus replication versus two-cycle G4x2
recommended_implementation_sequence.purpose: Select the smallest design that preserves useful throughput and macro feasibility.

recommended_implementation_sequence.deliverable: VCS cycle sweep and Synopsys logic/macro/energy evaluation for K1, single-G4, G4x2 and G4x4
recommended_implementation_sequence.purpose: Report Pareto points instead of a baseline-sensitive single ratio.

single_g4_k8_calibration_rtl.reason: Minimal executable step; M216 selection and M218 service control are substantially reusable, and it can expose real overhead without pretending to be the final throughput point.

g4x4_k8_rtl_now.reason: The four-read-per-bank requirement is unresolved and dominates the architectural choice.

beta48_enable_now.reason: M300 explicitly gates RTL after accuracy and an executable cycle adapter.

three_to_five_x_incremental_over_m218_k8.reason: At beta48, G4x4's task-only upper bound is 1.48x FC1 and 1.59x Conv over an equal-128-contribution M218 K8 geometry; a larger claim requires a different bottleneck or a weaker baseline.

p2_findings: The FC1 and Conv opportunity populations are frozen but not yet one common executable cycle population; M300 retains the population caveat.
M218/M219 DC is pre-macro, ideal-clock, ZeroWireload logic-only evidence; it does not price mask, activation, weight or accumulator SRAM macros.
Per-row quantization, bias, dequantization and no_running BN identity must be carried into the final interface contract.
claim_boundary: This review authorizes a design direction, not a performance result. No existing milestone, RTL, contract or docs/359 was modified.
